7694.text:
7694 paṭala ² n. 'roof, thatch' VarBr̥S. [Same as paṭala -¹?] Pa. paṭala - n. 'roof, ceiling'; Pk. paḍala - n. 'thatching
grass'; A. parali 'covering or screen of thatching grass'; — Si. paḷē (pl. paḷa ) 'thatch of a house' < * paḷal ? * paṭalāli -. Addenda: paṭali-²: read A. pârali .

7695.text:
7695 * paṭalāli 'the line of a thatch'. [ paṭala-², *āḍi -²] G. paṛāḷ n.f. 'slope of a roof', paṛāḷī f. 'one half of
sloping thatch, shed'?

7693.text:
7693 paṭala ¹ n. 'veil, cover' BhP., 'membrane (esp. round eyes), cataract' Suśr. [Cf. paṭa - m. 'veil' and * paṭṭa -³] Pa. paṭala - n. 'covering, membrane (of liver, stomach,
&c.)'; G. paṛaḷ n. 'film over eye', M. paḍaḷ n. — N. parelo prob. with H. Smith BSL 101, 116 < parivāra -.
